def transform(g):
    sep=next(v for r in g for v in [r[0]] if all(c==v for c in r))  # full horizontal row value
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(c==sep for c in r)]
    cols=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if all(g[i][j]==sep for i in range(len(g)))]
    def blocks(idxs,n):
        b=[];s=0
        for i in idxs+[n]: b.append((s,i)); s=i+1
        return b
    rb=blocks(rows,len(g)); cb=blocks(cols,len(g[0]))
    marker=set(v for r in g for v in r)-{sep}
    marker=list(marker)[0]
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in rb:
        row=[]
        for c0,c1 in cb:
            cnt=sum(g[i][j]==marker for i in range(r0,r1) for j in range(c0,c1))
            row.append(1 if cnt>=2 else next(v for r2 in g[r0:r1] for v in r2 if v!=sep))
        out.append(row)
    return out
